title: Analogical prompting 的两阶段提示模板
snippet: Instruction:\n1. Recall relevant exemplars for the current task.\n2. Solve the initial problem using the recalled exemplars.

title: OPRO 的 optimizer-evaluator 循环
snippet:
Initialize instruction x0
for t in 0..T-1:
    score xt on a validation set
    append (xt, score) to the optimization history
    ask the LLM to propose xt+1 from the sorted history
source_basis: Lecture pages 24-28 and the OPRO reading.

title: Self-Consistency 解码
snippet:
Sample N reasoning paths with diverse decoding
Extract final answers
Count answer frequencies
Return the majority answer

title: Tree-of-Thought 搜索流程
snippet:
Initialize frontier with the empty state
repeat:
    expand candidate next thoughts
    score partial states
    keep the best frontier states
until a complete solution is found or budget is exhausted

title: Self-Debugging 迭代
snippet:
Generate code
Run tests or inspect execution results
Ask the model to explain/debug the program
Revise the code using the observed feedback
source_basis: Lecture pages 63-65 and the Self-Debug reading.
